title: BiNVaST: niche boundary-preserving and synthetic data-guided variational autoencoders for concordant inference across high-resolution spatial transcriptomic platforms.

snippet: High-resolution spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables subcellular spatially resolved transcript profiling but remains difficult to annotate in complex tissues because of gene coverage and super sparseness in expression.
